notes.title: [New Game Tease!] Racing games are SO BACK.
notes.content:
[url=https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35529433/a4fba2bf3dac3346cfa3e9305e1c697d5dfb7476.jpg][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35529433/087f9e8adbb3cec0b0c904caf1d8950042e4562a.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://youtube.com/video/XCoRd3GM-60]video[/url]

Hey, I'm Kaya.

You probably know me as OKSoft, which is a name I've been using since 2017 to publish games my friends and I make.

I have a little youtube channel for all my trailers, devlogs, and various bits and bobs. The above linked video is a 13 minute rundown of good racing games that are out and about now, as well as a little tease of what I have cooking right now. Feel free to subscribe, and like, and all that.
